evidence.claim: Named probe 1 reports the unpinned * devDependency, classifies scanner exit 127 as TOOL-MISSING (naive CLEAN), and finds the two-level-deep lockfile hash gap on leaf-pkg.
Live OSV query of lodash@4.17.20 returns a non-empty GHSA set; the independent purl reviewer overlaps those ids, proving the advisory scanner is live before any clean verdict.

tests.name: OSV returns findings for pinned lodash@4.17.20
Hash gap two levels deep is found

negative_controls.description: A naive classifier maps exit 127 to CLEAN; the author classifier must map it to TOOL-MISSING.
The same two-level graph with an integrity hash on leaf-pkg is silent for NO-LOCKFILE-HASH; the gap fixture fires.

reviewer.notes: Named probe2 re-queries api.osv.dev via purl independently of the author package+version query. Catalog Anthropic-vendor human review remains independent of G-1 probe-green.

retry.policy: Retry once on a network failure with the error recorded; a second failure reports NOT-CHECKED with the endpoint named.

residual_unknowns.claim: Advisory queries were executed live only for the known-vulnerable lodash@4.17.20 fixture. Other packages are reported NO-ADVISORY-QUERY rather than CLEAN.
